_readme: UHN patient. Copy this file to hospital storage OUTSIDE the code repository and outside any folder connected to an AI tool, one file per patient. alias = study code only (no name, MRN or dates). cns_runCase refuses to run unless the case file, source.path and workDir are on hospital storage and reb.protocol is set. Import the DICOM on the UHN machine with cns_importDicom(dicomDir, 'D:/CNS_ESTRO_cases/CNS_01.mat').
